dashboard.title: Research
dashboard.scorableHint: Recordings that have both a model prediction and a reference class.
dashboard.emptyBody: Once recordings have been imported and assessed, their counts appear here. Nothing on this screen is estimated — every number is counted from this device.

labels.title: Reference labelling
labels.intro: Listen to the recording and record what it actually is, independently of what the model said. Your label is stored beside the model's prediction and never replaces it.
labels.emptyBody: There are no recordings on this device yet.
labels.modelSaidNothing: The model gave no classification for this recording.
labels.classHint: Required when you are recording agreement or naming a different class.

groundTruth.CORRECT_HINT: The reference agrees with the model's classification.
groundTruth.MODIFIED_HINT: You are naming the true class, which differs from the model's.
groundTruth.INCORRECT: The model was wrong, class unknown
groundTruth.INCORRECT_HINT: You can tell the model is wrong but not what this actually is. Counted, but it cannot be scored.
groundTruth.UNCERTAIN_HINT: The recording itself does not support a judgement.
groundTruth.NO_REFERENCE_AVAILABLE_HINT: There is no chest film, spirometry or other gold standard for this patient to compare against.

performance.title: Model performance
performance.intro: Computed only over recordings that have both a model prediction and a human reference class.
performance.insufficientBody: {{scored}} of the {{needed}} recordings needed have both a model prediction and a reference class. No metrics are shown, because a confusion matrix built from a handful of samples is more misleading than no matrix at all.
performance.underSupported: Fewer than {{n}} recordings of this class — read with caution.
performance.matrixCaption: Rows are the true class. Columns are what the model predicted.
performance.excludedBody: These recordings carry a reference label that cannot be placed in a confusion matrix. They are listed so the denominator above is accounted for.
performance.noRegression: Accuracy, precision, recall, specificity and F1 are the appropriate measures for a classifier. Error statistics such as RMSE and R² are not reported, because these are categorical labels and an error distance between class names has no meaning.

export.title: Export study data
export.privacyBody: The export carries the study identifier and never the patient's name, birth date, address or contact. Age in years replaces the birth date, and the number of days since the patient's first assessment replaces the calendar date. Clinical values are exported as codes rather than translated words, so exports from devices running in different languages can be pooled.
export.demoWarningBody: Demonstration mode is on, so the file will contain fictional records. Every row carries an isDemo column so they can be told apart, but they must be removed before any analysis.
export.emptyBody: There are no recordings on this device yet.
export.csvHint: One row per recording. Opens in a spreadsheet.
export.jsonHint: The same fields and the same order, as an array of objects.
